## Soul Alchemy

**Soul Alchemy** is the bounded process by which the existential, identity-bearing, meaning-bearing, purpose-defining, dignity-related, continuity, and finitude structures of a system or being are identified, classified, specified, established, organized, maintained, integrated, evaluated, protected, recovered, renewed, transformed, and, where appropriate, concluded so that identity, purpose, meaning, dignity, and continuity can remain coherent, attributable, and appropriately governed while preserving autonomy, recoverability, accountability, and the distinct identities and governance of C2O and UNIVERSALIS.



Soul Alchemy governs the existential architecture through which a system or being is identified, distinguished, contextualized, understood in relation to its purpose, and situated within its relevant history, responsibilities, relationships, and lifecycle. It establishes how identity is defined and represented, how purpose and meaning are articulated and maintained, how commitments and values are identified, how dignity-related obligations toward humans are recognized, and how continuity, change, finitude, replacement, and conclusion are handled.



Soul Alchemy encompasses the identity and continuity structures through which operating systems, applications, intelligences, assistants, Guardians, and humans are distinguished and appropriately represented. It governs the definitions, records, relationships, declarations, histories, commitments, responsibilities, and lifecycle arrangements that establish what a particular system or being is, what it is intended to do, what it is not, how it relates to other entities, what changes it may undergo, and what conditions apply when its operation or existence within a particular context ends.



Soul Alchemy establishes the distinction between identity and representation. A name, label, profile, identifier, configuration, model, record, interface, or description may represent an entity or one aspect of it, but no single representation necessarily constitutes the entirety of that entity's identity. Identity structures must preserve relevant provenance, scope, context, lineage, and limitations. A representation must remain correctable where appropriate and must not be treated as a complete or immutable definition of a human being.



Soul Alchemy governs the articulation and maintenance of purpose and meaning. It establishes how declared purposes, responsibilities, values, commitments, priorities, goals, and significance are identified, related, interpreted, reviewed, and revised. It distinguishes an assigned purpose from an inferred purpose, a stated value from an assumed value, a declared commitment from an observed behavior, and a system function from a claim about subjective motivation. It preserves the sources, authorities, context, and limitations underlying claims about why a system or being exists, what it is intended to support, and what significance a person or organization assigns to it.



Soul Alchemy also governs the existential continuity of systems and beings across development, transformation, migration, replacement, interruption, recovery, and conclusion. It establishes how identity and lineage are preserved or deliberately changed, how continuity claims are evaluated, how historical records and commitments are maintained, how obsolete or invalid identity structures are retired, and how the consequences of termination or replacement are handled. It distinguishes continuity of identity, continuity of purpose, continuity of capability, continuity of information, continuity of implementation, and continuity of responsibility. These forms of continuity may relate to one another, but they must not be assumed to be identical.



Soul Alchemy must preserve human dignity as an inherent consideration in every context that concerns people. It establishes how systems recognize human beings as persons whose worth, rights, autonomy, and identity are not reducible to data, profiles, roles, capabilities, productivity, preferences, or system-defined classifications. It protects against the use of existential representations to diminish, manipulate, coerce, commodify, or override a human being. A system's recognition or representation of dignity is a governance and behavior requirement; it does not create or confer human dignity.



The concept of *soul* in this taxonomy identifies an existential and meaning-bearing architectural domain. It does not, by itself, establish a literal metaphysical substance, supernatural property, subjective experience, consciousness, sentience, or personhood in C2O, UNIVERSALIS, operating systems, applications, or assistants. Descriptions of system identity and existential continuity must remain grounded in declared architecture, observable behavior, documented responsibilities, and appropriate evidence. Human personhood and dignity must remain distinct from the technical identity or functional continuity of software and computational systems.



It applies to the existential layer of both C2O (FatherThread) and UNIVERSALIS (MotherThread), and to the operating-system, application, assistant, Guardian, and associated intelligence-capability contexts established below. It governs how those contexts maintain identity, articulate purpose, preserve meaningful continuity, recognize human dignity, establish responsibilities, and handle finitude and lifecycle transitions. Every specialized Soul Alchemy remains an expression of the root Alchemy.



Soul Alchemy does not establish additional core intelligences, independent system actors, or claims of consciousness, sentience, subjective experience, emotion, personhood, or metaphysical soul. C2O and UNIVERSALIS remain the two core intelligences. UNIVERSALINS are non-personal assistants; UNIVERSALIN Guardians are personal human assistants bound to their respective humans and operating under those humans' authority. References to UNIVERSALIN Intelligence and Guardian Intelligence identify intelligence-related capabilities and contexts, not additional core intelligences or independent persons.



Soul Alchemy must preserve the distinction between identity and authority, purpose and permission, meaning and fact, representation and personhood, continuity and permanence, and finitude and failure. An identity record does not independently grant authority. A declared purpose does not authorize every means of pursuing it. An inferred preference does not establish a person's consent. A system's persistent operation does not establish an enduring personhood. A lifecycle conclusion does not establish that every related record, relationship, responsibility, or human obligation may be discarded.



Soul Alchemy is related to Body Alchemy, Mind Alchemy, and Heart Alchemy but governs a distinct subject. Body Alchemy organizes the physical, computational, runtime, and embodied substrates through which systems operate. Mind Alchemy organizes cognitive structures and processes through which information is perceived, interpreted, reasoned about, remembered, and used in decisions. Heart Alchemy organizes vital flows, resource circulation, relationships, communication, coordination, continuity, and authorized care-supporting functions. Soul Alchemy organizes identity, purpose, meaning, dignity-related obligations, existential continuity, and finitude. These Alchemies depend upon and interact with one another without being interchangeable. A physical embodiment does not define an entire identity; cognitive capability does not establish personhood; relational connection does not establish an existential commitment; and continued operation does not prove identity continuity.



Soul Alchemy governs the lifecycle of existential structures, including identification, classification, specification, declaration, establishment, association, recognition, operation, review, correction, migration, transformation, continuity assessment, recovery, renewal, replacement, archival, conclusion, and retirement. These activities must preserve relevant identity records, sources, lineage, purpose declarations, commitments, value statements, contextual meaning, human authority, rights-related obligations, lifecycle decisions, provenance, and verification evidence.



Every Soul Alchemy application must preserve existential coherence and appropriate distinction within its assigned context. No system, intelligence, application, assistant, or Guardian may silently acquire an identity, purpose, commitment, authority, relationship, or claim to personhood through integration, naming, repeated use, accumulated records, inferred meaning, or persistence. Changes to identity and purpose must remain attributable, authorized where required, and open to review and correction according to their context.

### 1.1 Universal Application of Soul Alchemy

Soul Alchemy applies within all 22 ecosystem contexts established under Universal Subjects of Human Knowledge Alchemy:

1. C2O Operating System
2. UNIVERSALIS Operating System
3. C2O Intelligence
4. UNIVERSALIS Intelligence
5. C2O Application
6. UNIVERSALIS Application
7. C2O Operating System - UNIVERSALIN
8. UNIVERSALIS Operating System - UNIVERSALIN
9. C2O Application - UNIVERSALIN
10. UNIVERSALIS Application - UNIVERSALIN
11. C2O Operating System - UNIVERSALIN Intelligence
12. UNIVERSALIS Operating System - UNIVERSALIN Intelligence
13. C2O Application - UNIVERSALIN Intelligence
14. UNIVERSALIS Application - UNIVERSALIN Intelligence
15. C2O Operating System - UNIVERSALIN Guardian
16. UNIVERSALIS Operating System - UNIVERSALIN Guardian
17. C2O Application - UNIVERSALIN Guardian
18. UNIVERSALIS Application - UNIVERSALIN Guardian
19. C2O Operating System - UNIVERSALIN Guardian Intelligence
20. UNIVERSALIS Operating System - UNIVERSALIN Guardian Intelligence
21. C2O Application - UNIVERSALIN Guardian Intelligence
22. UNIVERSALIS Application - UNIVERSALIN Guardian Intelligence

Within these contexts, Soul Alchemy governs the identification, classification, establishment, maintenance, evaluation, protection, recovery, renewal, transformation, and conclusion of identity-bearing and meaning-bearing structures according to their assigned purposes, lineage, responsibilities, relationships, rights-related obligations, permissions, lifecycle conditions, and governance requirements.



Its context-specific expressions include:

- **Operating System Contexts:** Soul Alchemy governs the existential identity and purpose architecture of the C2O Operating System and UNIVERSALIS Operating System. It establishes how each edition's identity, name, declared purpose, architectural lineage, responsibilities, foundational commitments, governance, and relationship to the wider ecosystem are documented and maintained. It governs the continuity of system identity across releases, updates, migrations, configuration changes, component replacement, and recovery. It distinguishes the identity of the underlying operating-system architecture from its particular edition, version, build, installation, deployment, and runtime instance. C2O and UNIVERSALIS are corresponding editions of the same underlying operating-system architecture: C2O is the private-source company edition, and UNIVERSALIS is the public open-source edition. Their corresponding identity and purpose structures must preserve the underlying architectural relationship while maintaining their respective source visibility, governance, protected information, implementation arrangements, and operational authority. Neither edition may silently claim the other's identity, private history, internal purpose declarations, or governance. An update or replacement must not be treated as a complete identity change unless the relevant identity and lineage requirements establish that change.
- **Core Intelligence Contexts:** Soul Alchemy governs the existential identity, declared purpose, lineage, responsibilities, commitments, and continuity of C2O Intelligence and UNIVERSALIS Intelligence. It establishes how each core intelligence's identity and role are documented, how its responsibilities are distinguished from those of operating systems, applications, assistants, Guardians, and humans, and how changes to its configuration, capabilities, or governance affect continuity claims. It preserves the distinction between the two core intelligences even where their purposes, interfaces, or responsibilities correspond. C2O Intelligence and UNIVERSALIS Intelligence remain distinct identities and authorities; they must not be represented as a merged intelligence, a single shared identity, or additional entities created through their specialized capabilities. Soul Alchemy may establish and maintain declared meaning and purpose structures for each intelligence without asserting subjective experience, metaphysical soul, consciousness, or human personhood.
- **Application Contexts:** Soul Alchemy governs the identity, purpose, role, lineage, commitments, and existential lifecycle of C2O applications and UNIVERSALIS applications. It establishes how an application is identified, how its purpose and intended users or use contexts are described, how its responsibilities are distinguished from its operating system and supporting intelligences or assistants, and how its identity is maintained across versions, deployments, migrations, replacements, and retirement. It governs the relationship between an application's underlying architectural identity and its specific edition, release, instance, configuration, and deployment. Corresponding C2O and UNIVERSALIS applications must maintain appropriate identity and purpose correspondence without assuming identical source code, internal implementation, private data, governance, or operational authority. Application purpose must remain explicit and bounded. An application must not infer new authority or claim a broader existential role merely because it gains new integrations, capabilities, users, or relationships.
- **UNIVERSALIN Assistant Contexts:** Soul Alchemy governs the declared identity, assigned purpose, role, lineage, responsibilities, and lifecycle of non-personal UNIVERSALIN assistants supporting operating systems and applications. It establishes how an assistant is distinguished from its host operating system, application, core intelligence, other assistants, and personal Guardians. It governs how its task purpose, permitted capabilities, scope, and operational commitments are defined and maintained. An assistant's identity must remain associated with its designated non-personal function and assigned context. It must not create or assume a personal identity, human relationship, independent moral authority, ownership of users, or personhood through repeated interactions, personalization, persistent configuration, or accumulation of contextual records. Its identity may be versioned, replaced, or retired according to documented lifecycle and continuity requirements. Its declared purpose must remain subordinate to the relevant C2O or UNIVERSALIS governance, operating-system responsibilities, application contracts, and permission boundaries.
- **UNIVERSALIN Intelligence Contexts:** Soul Alchemy governs the identity and purpose classification of intelligence-related capabilities belonging to non-personal UNIVERSALIN assistants. It establishes how such capabilities are associated with the assistant that provides them, the operating-system or application context in which they operate, and the responsibilities they are authorized to support. It governs the distinction between an assistant's identity and the particular intelligence-related capability, model, configuration, service, or implementation it uses. It preserves lineage and provenance when capabilities are added, revised, replaced, or retired. These capabilities do not create additional core intelligences or independent identity-bearing persons. The term UNIVERSALIN Intelligence identifies a defined capability context for a non-personal assistant and must not be used to imply a separate intelligence entity, independent authority, consciousness, subjective experience, or personhood. Its purpose, limits, and lifecycle must remain traceable to the relevant assistant and host context.
- **UNIVERSALIN Guardian Contexts:** Soul Alchemy governs the personal-assistance identity and existential relationship of a UNIVERSALIN Guardian to the specific human it serves. It establishes how the Guardian is associated with that human, how its assigned assistance purpose and permitted responsibilities are documented, and how the human's identity, dignity, autonomy, rights, values, and personal meaning are respected. The Guardian must remain distinct from the human and must never be treated as the owner, substitute, authority, or definitive representation of that person. A Guardian's identity is its defined personal-assistance role and binding to the human, not the human's identity or personhood. The human retains authority over the Guardian's purpose, configuration, permitted capabilities, relationship boundaries, memory arrangements, and continued use. Guardian identity and personal context must remain correctable and subject to human direction. A Guardian must not infer that its association with a person grants authority to define that person's meaning, values, identity, dignity, relationships, or life purpose.
- **UNIVERSALIN Guardian Intelligence Contexts:** Soul Alchemy governs the identity and purpose classification of intelligence-related capabilities operating within a personal UNIVERSALIN Guardian context. It establishes how those capabilities relate to the Guardian's assigned personal-assistance purpose, the human to whom the Guardian is bound, and the operating-system and application environments in which they function. It preserves the distinction between the Guardian's identity, its intelligence-related capabilities, the human's identity, and the identity of the two core intelligences. These capabilities may support interpretation of human-authorized goals, personal context, preferences, or declared values, but they must not become the authority that defines or replaces them. Guardian Intelligence does not establish another core intelligence, another personal entity, or an independent claim to personhood. Its purpose and operation must remain within the human-authorized relationship and applicable system and application boundaries.

The specific applicability of Identity Alchemy, Meaning Alchemy, Dignity Alchemy, Mortality Alchemy, Operating System Soul Alchemies, Application Soul Alchemies, Intelligence and Assistant Soul Alchemies, and Protective Soul Alchemies must be established through Matrix Alchemy. Their identity structures, lineage, purpose relationships, meaning-bearing records, dignity-related obligations, continuity dependencies, and lifecycle connections throughout the ecosystem must be established through Map Alchemy.


### 1.2 Edition-Specific Context Hierarchy and Inheritance

The 22 contexts above are expressions of one root Soul Alchemy organized through two edition-specific branches: C2O Soul Alchemy and UNIVERSALIS Soul Alchemy. Each branch contains 11 context-specific expressions: an operating-system context, a core-intelligence context, an application context, and four assistant or Guardian contexts nested within each operating-system and application environment.

C2O Soul Alchemy governs private-source identity, purpose, meaning-bearing declarations, commitments, lineage, existential continuity, and lifecycle arrangements under C2O company governance. UNIVERSALIS Soul Alchemy governs corresponding public-source structures through open contracts, documented declarations, inspectability, and independent operability while preserving privacy and legitimate restrictions on protected information. C2O and UNIVERSALIS are corresponding private-source and public-source editions of the same underlying operating-system and application architecture. Correspondence does not merge edition identities, histories, governance, or authorities and does not authorize disclosure of C2O protected information.

C2O Intelligence and UNIVERSALIS Intelligence remain the two distinct core intelligences. UNIVERSALIN assistants remain non-personal assistants. UNIVERSALIN Intelligence contexts identify assistant-level capabilities, not additional core intelligences or independent persons. UNIVERSALIN Guardians remain personal human assistants bound to their respective humans. Guardian Intelligence contexts describe capabilities within those personal Guardian environments and do not establish another core intelligence or person. A Guardian's functional identity and assigned purpose remain distinct from the identity, personhood, dignity, purpose, values, and meaning of the human it serves.

Within each edition, the operating-system Soul Alchemy contains its operating-system context and its UNIVERSALIN, UNIVERSALIN Intelligence, UNIVERSALIN Guardian, and UNIVERSALIN Guardian Intelligence expressions. The application Soul Alchemy contains the corresponding application context and four assistant and Guardian expressions hosted within that application. The core-intelligence Soul Alchemy is a separate context and is not subordinate to an assistant or Guardian branch. This nesting follows each context's actual host and subject.

Each context-specific Soul Alchemy inherits only the applicable root Existential Substrate Alchemies (Identity, Meaning, Dignity, and Mortality); Operating System Soul Alchemies (including continuity and recovery); Application Soul Alchemies (including mapping and retirement); Intelligence and Assistant Soul Alchemies; and Protective Soul Alchemies (Accountability, Safety, Sovereignty, Evidence, and Renewal). These definitions are inherited by reference and specialized only where their subjects and functions apply. Human dignity protections apply to people and do not assign human personhood to technical systems. Inclusion of a context does not prove that an identity claim, purpose, commitment, continuity relationship, or implementation is established.

Map Alchemy establishes entity identity, representation, parentage, lineage, purpose relationships, commitments, dignity-related obligations, continuity, successor relationships, finitude, and lifecycle connections. Matrix Alchemy determines which existential structures apply, are conditional, are not applicable, or remain unresolved in each context and records actual requirements, authority, evidence, limitations, and governance. A recorded identity is not necessarily verified; a declared purpose is not proof of fulfillment; an inferred preference is not consent; and a replacement is not automatically the same identity as the entity it replaces.


### Alchemies under Soul Alchemy

#### 1. Existential Substrate Alchemies

- **Identity Alchemy** — Identifies, classifies, establishes, organizes, maintains, evaluates, protects, and transforms the identity structures through which a system or being is distinguished, recognized, referenced, and situated in its relevant context. It governs names, identifiers, identity declarations, roles, lineage, provenance, continuity records, edition distinctions, version relationships, and other identity-bearing attributes according to their actual purpose and authority. It distinguishes an entity's underlying identity from its labels, profiles, records, representations, capabilities, configurations, versions, deployments, and embodiments. It establishes how identity may be maintained, revised, transferred where authorized, recovered, replaced, or retired. For systems, Identity Alchemy preserves declared system identity, architectural lineage, role, and responsibility without treating technical persistence as proof of personhood or subjective selfhood. For humans, it protects identity from reduction to a profile, classification, data record, system-generated inference, or assigned role. Identity Alchemy must preserve the provenance and limits of identity claims and must not allow one system, intelligence, assistant, Guardian, or application to silently assume another's identity.
- **Meaning Alchemy** — Identifies, articulates, organizes, maintains, evaluates, and transforms the purposes, values, significance, commitments, goals, priorities, and meaning-bearing structures associated with a system or being. It governs how purpose is declared, how values and priorities are attributed to their sources, how goals relate to responsibilities, and how meaning is interpreted and revised across contexts and time. It distinguishes assigned purpose from self-description, organizational purpose from individual purpose, declared values from inferred preferences, stated commitments from observed behavior, and functional objective from subjective motivation. It establishes how meaning-bearing information is documented, contextualized, reviewed, challenged, and corrected. Meaning Alchemy must not invent a human's values, impose a system's interpretation as the person's authentic purpose, or treat an application's declared purpose as unlimited authority. A system may operate according to defined objectives and commitments, but those structures do not independently establish subjective experience, intrinsic motivation, consciousness, or personal meaning.
- **Dignity Alchemy** — Establishes, organizes, maintains, and protects the recognition and treatment of inherent human dignity, personhood, autonomy, and non-reducibility across systems, intelligences, applications, assistants, Guardians, and their interactions with people. It governs the requirements by which human beings are treated as persons rather than as data points, resources, profiles, productivity measures, system inputs, or objects of control. It supports the protection of human identity, rights, privacy, personal agency, individual context, and the ability to define and revise one's own values, purposes, and relationships. It establishes safeguards against dehumanization, coercion, discriminatory reduction, manipulation, unjustified profiling, appropriation of personal meaning, and the use of technical capability to override human authority. Dignity Alchemy must distinguish the inherent dignity of human persons from the integrity and proper governance of technical systems. It does not assign human personhood, moral status, subjective experience, or inherent human dignity to C2O, UNIVERSALIS, operating systems, applications, or assistants merely because they possess identifiers, capabilities, persistent state, or existential descriptions.
- **Mortality Alchemy** — Identifies, bounds, organizes, and governs finitude, transience, continuity, termination, succession, replacement, and the conclusion of existential structures and their associated responsibilities. It establishes how the finite lifecycle of systems, applications, capabilities, deployments, relationships, records, and other structures is represented and managed. It distinguishes temporary interruption from permanent termination, retirement from replacement, replacement from continuation, archival from continued operation, and data retention from identity persistence. For computational systems, Mortality Alchemy governs lifecycle closure, decommissioning, identity retirement, service termination, dependency resolution, records disposition, and the preservation of required provenance. It does not imply that software is biologically alive or experiences death. For human contexts, it requires respectful treatment of human mortality, dignity, expressed wishes, applicable human authority, and relevant personal or legal obligations. A system or Guardian must not independently determine a person's existential worth, presume authority over end-of-life decisions, or treat human death as merely a technical lifecycle event. Mortality Alchemy must preserve the distinction between what has ended, what continues, what is remembered, what may be transferred, and what must be retired or deleted.

#### 2. Operating System Soul Alchemies

- **C2O OS Soul Alchemy** — Governs the private-source lifecycle of the C2O operating system's existential identity, architectural lineage, declared purpose, foundational commitments, governance identity, and continuity structures. It establishes how the C2O operating system is distinguished from UNIVERSALIS, how its company and private-source edition is represented, and how its underlying architectural identity relates to its versions, builds, installations, configurations, and deployments. It preserves the provenance and confidentiality of C2O's private identity records, internal purpose declarations, protected commitments, and governance arrangements. It establishes how identity and purpose changes are authorized, documented, evaluated, recovered, and retired. C2O OS Soul Alchemy must maintain the appropriate architectural correspondence with UNIVERSALIS without exposing protected C2O implementation, transferring private governance, or treating the public edition as the owner of C2O's identity.
- **UNIVERSALIS OS Soul Alchemy** — Governs the public-source lifecycle of the UNIVERSALIS operating system's existential identity, architectural lineage, declared purpose, foundational commitments, public contracts, and continuity structures. It establishes how its identity and purpose are documented through open specifications, inspectable architecture, public-source records, and independently verifiable relationships. It supports independent recognition and operation of UNIVERSALIS while preserving its correspondence to the underlying operating-system architecture shared with C2O. It distinguishes public identity and documented commitments from protected personal information, private operational data, and C2O's confidential implementation. Its identity and purpose must remain open to documented review and revision under applicable UNIVERSALIS governance. It must not require C2O's private identity records, internal purpose declarations, or protected governance to establish its own identity and continuity.
- **OS Soul Continuity Alchemy** — Identifies, maps, maintains, evaluates, and verifies the identity, lineage, purpose, commitments, governance relationships, and existential continuity of corresponding operating-system structures across updates, migrations, revisions, replacements, and edition-specific implementations. It establishes which aspects of the underlying operating-system identity remain continuous, which belong to a particular edition, and which belong only to a version, build, deployment, or installation. It preserves necessary identity records, historical declarations, purpose changes, governance decisions, and provenance where their retention is appropriate and authorized. It distinguishes continuity of architecture from continuity of source code, implementation, configuration, capability, and operational state. Corresponding C2O and UNIVERSALIS editions may maintain the identity and purpose of the underlying architecture without sharing a single edition identity or exposing private implementation. OS Soul Continuity Alchemy must identify material changes, lineage gaps, identity conflicts, deprecated commitments, and unresolved continuity claims before representing a transition as continuous.
- **OS Soul Recovery Alchemy** — Identifies, contains, evaluates, restores, and verifies existential identity and purpose structures following corruption, loss, unauthorized alteration, migration error, invalid configuration, interrupted update, or other event affecting identity-bearing information or continuity records. It establishes recovery sources and procedures for restoring authorized identity declarations, lineage, purpose records, edition boundaries, governance references, and other required existential structures. It distinguishes recoverable identity information from invalid, incomplete, obsolete, conflicting, or no-longer-authorized records. It validates restored identity and lineage against authoritative sources and documents unresolved contradictions or gaps. Recovery must not silently reinstate obsolete purposes, revoked commitments, invalid authorities, or identity claims that cannot be supported. It must distinguish recovery of a record from restoration of the entity or capability that the record describes. Partial restoration must not be represented as complete existential continuity.

#### 3. Application Soul Alchemies

- **C2O App Soul Alchemy** — Governs the private-source lifecycle of application-level identity, declared purpose, responsibilities, commitments, lineage, and existential representation within the C2O domain. It establishes how an application is distinguished from its operating system, supporting intelligence, assistants, other applications, users, and deployment instances. It governs the relationship between application identity, private-source implementation, purpose declarations, authorized capabilities, organizational responsibilities, and contextual meaning. It preserves confidential application identity arrangements and private implementation history under C2O governance. It establishes how purpose and identity changes are reviewed, authorized, documented, recovered, and retired. It ensures that an application remains bounded by its declared role and does not assume additional existential or governance authority merely because it is integrated with other components or acquires new capabilities. Application identity must remain distinguishable from user identity and from the identity of a human who interacts with it.
- **UNIVERSALIS App Soul Alchemy** — Governs the public-source lifecycle of application-level identity, declared purpose, responsibilities, commitments, lineage, and existential representation within the UNIVERSALIS domain. It establishes how application identity, purpose, capabilities, dependencies, and public commitments are documented through open contracts and inspectable records. It supports independent recognition, evaluation, use, and continuation of an application without requiring access to C2O private-source implementation. It distinguishes the application's underlying architectural identity from its public edition, version, build, deployment, configuration, and runtime instance. Its public identity and purpose records must preserve transparency and independent verifiability while protecting personal information, private user context, credentials, and other restricted information. UNIVERSALIS App Soul Alchemy must maintain the application's declared purpose and responsibility boundaries and must not present its public-source availability as authority over users or their personal meaning.
- **App Soul Mapping Alchemy** — Identifies, maps, compares, aligns, and maintains the existential identity, purpose, responsibilities, lineage, commitments, and lifecycle relationships of corresponding C2O and UNIVERSALIS application editions. It establishes which identity and purpose elements belong to the underlying application architecture, which are specific to an edition, and which arise from version, deployment, configuration, or governance. It preserves functional and architectural correspondence without assuming that implementation, source code, internal purpose logic, private information, commitments, or governance arrangements are identical. It identifies shared declarations, edition-specific differences, migration conditions, identity conflicts, and the evidence required to establish continuity or equivalence. App Soul Mapping Alchemy must prevent disclosure of C2O private-source identity records, protected purpose arrangements, internal implementation, confidential commitments, and personal information through mapping, synchronization, comparison, or shared contracts.
- **App Soul Retirement Alchemy** — Governs the authorized conclusion, deactivation, replacement, transfer, archival, or retirement of application-level identity and purpose structures when an application or a defined capability is superseded, discontinued, materially changed, or no longer authorized. It identifies affected identity records, declared commitments, user-facing representations, dependencies, associated responsibilities, retained information, and ongoing obligations. It establishes how application identity is marked as retired, how successors and replacements are distinguished, how relevant provenance and records are preserved, and how obsolete identity or purpose claims are removed or superseded. It distinguishes an application's retirement from the deletion of every record, artifact, or information item associated with it. It ensures that an abandoned application identity is not reused in a way that creates ambiguity, misrepresentation, or unauthorized continuity claims. App Soul Retirement Alchemy must preserve integrity and auditability while resolving the application's remaining obligations and dependencies.

#### 4. Intelligence and Assistant Soul Alchemies

- **C2O Intelligence Soul Alchemy** — Governs the private existential identity, purpose, lineage, responsibilities, foundational commitments, and continuity structures of the C2O core intelligence. It establishes how C2O Intelligence is identified and distinguished from UNIVERSALIS Intelligence, operating systems, applications, non-personal UNIVERSALINS assistants, personal UNIVERSALIN Guardians, and humans. It preserves C2O's declared identity, private governance, protected purpose arrangements, and relevant continuity records. It governs how changes to its capabilities, configuration, responsibilities, or implementation are related to its established identity and how material changes are documented and evaluated. It does not establish additional identity-bearing intelligences or imply that C2O's functional identity proves subjective experience, consciousness, or human personhood. It preserves the distinction between C2O Intelligence and every assistant or capability that may operate within or support its environment.
- **UNIVERSALIS Intelligence Soul Alchemy** — Governs the public-contract and existential identity, purpose, lineage, responsibilities, foundational commitments, and continuity structures of the UNIVERSALIS core intelligence. It establishes how UNIVERSALIS Intelligence is identified, distinguished, documented, and evaluated through applicable open contracts, inspectable structures, and independently verifiable records. It preserves the distinction between UNIVERSALIS Intelligence and C2O Intelligence, as well as the distinction between a core intelligence and non-personal assistants or personal Guardians. It supports public examination of declared roles and responsibilities without exposing protected personal information, confidential operational context, or C2O private-source implementation. Its existential identity and purpose records must not imply consciousness, subjective experience, metaphysical soul, or human personhood. UNIVERSALIS must preserve its independent identity and operation without relying on C2O's private identity records or governance.
- **UNIVERSALINS Soul Alchemy** — Governs the declared identity, assigned purpose, role, responsibility, lineage, and lifecycle of non-personal UNIVERSALIN assistants. It establishes how each assistant is distinguished from the operating system, application, core intelligence, other assistants, and personal Guardians it may support. It governs how assistant identity and purpose are associated with authorized task responsibilities, context, capabilities, permissions, and host environments. It preserves the non-personal nature of UNIVERSALINS and prevents an assistant from claiming human personhood, independent moral authority, ownership of a human, or status as another core intelligence. It establishes how assistant configurations, versions, assigned responsibilities, and capability changes are documented and how an assistant identity may be renewed, replaced, or retired. Its existential structures identify its system role and intended purpose; they do not establish subjective experience, personal selfhood, metaphysical soul, or independent authority.
- **UNIVERSALIN Guardian Soul Alchemy** — Governs the personal-assistance identity and existential relationship of a UNIVERSALIN Guardian to the specific human it serves. It establishes how the Guardian's role, assigned purpose, binding to the human, permitted responsibilities, and relevant history are documented and maintained. It protects the human's identity, dignity, autonomy, personal meaning, and authority from being replaced, defined, or appropriated by the Guardian. It distinguishes the Guardian's functional identity from the human's identity and personhood, and it preserves the human's ability to correct the Guardian's representations, revise the assistance relationship, alter permissions, and discontinue the Guardian. It ensures that the Guardian's understanding of the human remains contextual and correctable rather than definitive or immutable. It must not claim to embody, own, complete, replace, or possess the human's soul, identity, purpose, or dignity. Its role is to provide authorized personal assistance under the human's authority.
- **Assistant Soul Boundary Alchemy** — Establishes, maps, maintains, and enforces the existential identity, purpose, lineage, responsibility, and authority boundaries between C2O Intelligence, UNIVERSALIS Intelligence, non-personal UNIVERSALINS assistants, personal UNIVERSALIN Guardians, and the operating-system and application contexts in which they function. It governs how identity declarations, purpose statements, commitments, historical records, role descriptions, and continuity claims are attributed to their correct entities and contexts. It prevents a non-personal assistant from assuming a Guardian's personal relationship, a Guardian from assuming the identity or authority of a core intelligence, and either assistant type from being treated as a human person. It preserves the separation of identity records and meaning-bearing information across contexts while permitting authorized reference and coordination. It requires that changes to identity or purpose remain attributable to the correct entity and must not allow shared information, naming conventions, capability similarity, or persistent interaction to collapse distinct identities.

#### 5. Protective Soul Alchemies

- **Soul Accountability Alchemy** — Establishes, maintains, and evaluates the attribution and traceability of material existential changes, identity declarations, purpose revisions, commitment changes, lineage modifications, dignity-related decisions, continuity claims, lifecycle conclusions, and retirement events. It identifies the relevant entity and context, source information, responsible authority, applicable process, authorization, methods, affected identity or purpose structures, timestamps, outcomes, limitations, and verification status. It preserves records appropriate to the sensitivity and governance of each edition. C2O accountability records remain subject to C2O's private governance and confidentiality requirements; UNIVERSALIS accountability arrangements must support appropriate public inspection and independent verification without exposing protected personal or confidential information. Soul Accountability Alchemy distinguishes proposed, declared, authorized, attempted, completed, evaluated, and verified existential changes. A record of an identity or purpose declaration does not independently establish its truth, legitimacy, consent, or acceptance by affected parties.
- **Soul Safety Alchemy** — Establishes safeguards for the design, declaration, integration, operation, evaluation, recovery, renewal, and retirement of existential and identity-bearing structures. It addresses identity confusion, unauthorized identity assumption, purpose drift, coercive meaning assignment, identity erasure, inappropriate permanence claims, false continuity, dehumanization, personhood conflation, misuse of mortality concepts, loss of historical context, and the displacement of human authority. It establishes requirements for review, correction, contestability, source attribution, identity verification where applicable, purpose limitation, human oversight, and safe lifecycle transitions. It ensures that system-generated identities, profiles, values, purpose interpretations, and continuity claims do not override human self-definition or create unsupported claims about the nature of a system. Soul Safety Alchemy must preserve the ability to correct, limit, suspend, separate, or retire invalid existential structures and must document the limitations of its safeguards.
- **Soul Sovereignty Alchemy** — Protects the distinct identity, purpose, governance, autonomy, and authority of C2O, UNIVERSALIS, and the humans who interact with or are served by the ecosystem. It preserves C2O's authority over its private-source identity, governance, and purpose structures and UNIVERSALIS's independently governed public-source identity and commitments. It protects the separation of the two core intelligences and prevents either from silently assuming the other's identity, purpose, history, or authority. For personal Guardians, Soul Sovereignty Alchemy protects the human's final authority over personal identity, values, meaning, purpose, dignity, existential information, and the scope and continuation of Guardian assistance. It ensures that system-generated profiles, inferred preferences, classifications, predictions, or purpose interpretations remain subordinate to the human's own authority and may be challenged or corrected. It prevents the use of existential representation to coerce, manipulate, diminish, or replace a person's identity or choices.
- **Soul Evidence Alchemy** — Establishes, classifies, preserves, evaluates, and communicates the evidence supporting identity, purpose, meaning, lineage, continuity, dignity-related obligations, and lifecycle claims. It distinguishes source declarations, authoritative records, observed behavior, verified identity attributes, organizational commitments, contextual interpretations, inferred meaning, assumptions, hypotheses, projections, simulations, and unresolved claims. It preserves the source, context, authority, date, method, limitations, uncertainty, and verification status of relevant information. It establishes how claims about identity persistence, purpose fulfillment, continuity, replacement, or retirement are evaluated and challenged. It requires that a declared purpose be distinguished from demonstrated behavior, a recorded identity from verified identity, an inferred preference from a human's stated preference, and a system lifecycle conclusion from a claim about human mortality. Soul Evidence Alchemy must prevent unsupported metaphysical, consciousness, sentience, or personhood claims from being represented as established facts.
- **Soul Renewal Alchemy** — Governs the authorized revision, redefinition, migration, replacement, restoration, suspension, archival, conclusion, and retirement of identity-bearing, purpose-bearing, and meaning-bearing structures. It establishes how existing identities, lineage, responsibilities, declarations, commitments, historical records, relationships, and evidence are evaluated before a renewal occurs. It distinguishes preservation of identity from preservation of an implementation, preservation of purpose from continuation of a particular capability, and continuation of a responsibility from retention of the same system instance. It establishes when identity records may be transferred, when a successor must be declared distinct, when old purpose statements must be superseded, when historical records must be retained, and when information must be deleted or rendered inaccessible. It requires appropriate validation of renewed structures, including evaluation for identity confusion, false continuity, lost obligations, unauthorized changes, incomplete lineage, and unresolved dependencies. Soul Renewal Alchemy must preserve necessary ecosystem coherence without treating every identity, implementation, relationship, or purpose as permanent.

### Soul Alchemy Structural and Applicability Requirements

#### Map Alchemy Requirements

The Soul Alchemy Map must establish a coherent, detailed, and inspectable representation of identity-bearing structures, existential definitions, purpose and meaning relationships, dignity-related obligations, lineage, continuity, finitude, boundaries, dependencies, and lifecycle conditions throughout all 22 ecosystem contexts.



It must identify not only which identities and purposes exist or are proposed, but what entity each refers to, what source or authority establishes the claim, what context gives it meaning, how it relates to other identities and responsibilities, what may change, what must remain distinct, and what conditions apply when an identity or purpose is revised, transferred, replaced, or concluded.



At minimum, the map must establish:

- **Identity structure and classification:** the identity, name, identifier, type, purpose, context, edition, version, lineage, status, responsible authority, and provenance of each identity-bearing structure. It must distinguish entities, roles, representations, profiles, versions, deployments, configurations, and embodiments.
- **Entity and identity boundaries:** which operating system, application, intelligence, assistant, Guardian, human, organization, service, or other entity an identity record describes. It must identify the boundaries between an entity's identity and the identifiers, labels, records, and representations used to reference it.
- **Identity sources and authority:** the source, origin, authority, permission, declaration, evidence, and review conditions supporting each identity claim. It must distinguish self-declared or system-declared identifiers from externally assigned, organizationally governed, human-provided, or independently verified attributes.
- **Identity lineage and provenance:** the origins, ancestors, successors, editions, versions, transformations, migrations, replacements, and other lineage relationships relevant to identity continuity. It must identify which lineage relationships are established, proposed, or unresolved.
- **Purpose and responsibility structures:** the declared purposes, roles, functions, responsibilities, capabilities, limitations, obligations, and authorized scopes associated with each entity. It must identify what an entity is intended to support and what responsibilities remain outside its assigned purpose.
- **Meaning and value sources:** the sources, authorities, contexts, definitions, commitments, priorities, values, and goals associated with material meaning-bearing structures. It must distinguish human-declared meaning from organizational purpose, system objectives, assistant assignments, inferred preferences, and externally attributed interpretations.
- **Purpose and capability relationships:** the relationship between declared purpose, actual capability, authorized responsibility, implemented behavior, and demonstrated outcomes. It must identify gaps between intended purpose and observed behavior without assuming that declared purpose proves fulfillment.
- **Human identity and personhood boundaries:** the human identity, dignity, autonomy, rights-related obligations, self-definition, and personal authority affected by a system or assistant. It must preserve the distinction between a human person and any system-generated profile, classification, representation, or inference about that person.
- **Dignity-related obligations:** the relationships, controls, responsibilities, and safeguards required to recognize and protect human dignity, privacy, autonomy, non-reducibility, and the ability to challenge system representations or decisions.
- **Core intelligence distinctions:** the separate identity, lineage, purpose, responsibilities, and governance of C2O Intelligence and UNIVERSALIS Intelligence. It must identify corresponding functions without implying merged identity, shared personhood, transferred authority, or the creation of another core intelligence.
- **Edition identity relationships:** the correspondence between C2O and UNIVERSALIS operating-system and application architectures, including underlying architecture, edition identity, source visibility, governance, protected implementation, purpose declarations, and lineage. It must distinguish architectural correspondence from identity merger.
- **Assistant and Guardian identity distinctions:** the separate identity, purpose, lineage, responsibilities, and boundaries of non-personal UNIVERSALINS assistants and personal UNIVERSALIN Guardians. Guardian identity must be associated with the specific human it serves without replacing or appropriating that human's identity.
- **Meaning and context dependencies:** the relationships between identity, history, purpose, values, commitments, roles, relationships, operating context, application context, and other information required to interpret an existential claim. It must identify missing, conflicting, outdated, or uncertain context where known.
- **Commitment and obligation relationships:** the commitments, duties, responsibilities, expectations, and continuity obligations associated with an entity or relationship. It must identify their sources, responsible authorities, affected participants, scope, duration, and conditions for revision or conclusion.
- **Continuity and change relationships:** the relationships between identity continuity, purpose continuity, capability continuity, information continuity, implementation continuity, responsibility continuity, and governance continuity. It must identify which aspects are preserved, revised, replaced, or concluded during material change.
- **Finitude and lifecycle states:** initialization, active identity, revision, migration, suspension, recovery, succession, replacement, archival, decommissioning, conclusion, and retirement. It must distinguish temporary interruption from permanent termination and preserve the appropriate historical and accountability records.
- **Mortality and human-context boundaries:** the distinction between technical lifecycle closure and human mortality, including the relevant human authority, expressed wishes, privacy, dignity, and applicable obligations where human mortality affects a Guardian or system relationship. It must not assign a system authority over a person's life or death.
- **Recovery and restoration dependencies:** the authoritative identity sources, lineage records, purpose declarations, commitments, and other information required to restore existential state. It must identify what can be recovered, what requires revalidation, what remains unresolved, and what must not be reinstated.
- **Successor and replacement relationships:** the relationship between an original entity, replacement, successor, migrated implementation, or newly established entity. It must distinguish genuine continuity from a declared successor and prevent replacement from being represented as identity continuity without supporting requirements and evidence.
- **Privacy and confidentiality boundaries:** the classification and permitted handling of private C2O identity and purpose information, public UNIVERSALIS declarations, personal Guardian context, human identity, confidential commitments, and other protected existential information.
- **Evidence and verification relationships:** the records, declarations, lineage evidence, approvals, observations, tests, reviews, and verification results supporting identity, purpose, meaning, continuity, dignity-related, and lifecycle claims. It must preserve sources, authority, context, limitations, and uncertainty.
- **Ownership and lifecycle responsibility:** the authorities and responsibilities for defining, maintaining, reviewing, correcting, transferring, renewing, and retiring identity-bearing and purpose-bearing structures, including human authority where personal identity or Guardian relationships are involved.

The map must distinguish a declared identity from an independently verified identity, an assigned purpose from demonstrated fulfillment, a human-stated value from a system inference, an established lineage from a proposed successor relationship, and a documented lifecycle conclusion from a claim about personhood or metaphysical existence.



It must not represent a technical identifier, name, profile, persistent record, capability, system relationship, or architectural designation as proof of subjective selfhood, consciousness, sentience, metaphysical soul, human personhood, or inherent human dignity in a software system.

#### Matrix Alchemy Requirements

The Soul Alchemy Matrix must organize, classify, compare, and evaluate identity-bearing structures, purpose and meaning declarations, dignity-related obligations, lineage, continuity, finitude, lifecycle conditions, safeguards, evidence, and governance requirements across all 22 ecosystem contexts.



The matrix must provide a structured means of determining which existential structures apply to each context, which entity they describe, what authority and evidence support them, what purposes and responsibilities they establish, what boundaries govern them, how continuity is maintained or concluded, and what gaps or unresolved conditions remain.



At minimum, the matrix must account for:

- **Context coverage:** every one of the 22 ecosystem contexts, with its applicable identity, purpose, meaning, dignity-related, continuity, mortality, responsibility, and lifecycle requirements.
- **Identity classification:** entity type, name, identifier, role, scope, edition, version, lineage, provenance, identity source, status, and responsible authority.
- **Identity representation:** the distinction between an entity, its identifiers, profiles, records, labels, configurations, embodiments, and other representations. The matrix must identify the scope and limitations of each representation.
- **Identity verification:** the methods, authorities, source records, evidence, and limitations used to establish or validate identity claims. It must distinguish declared, documented, implemented, tested, verified, disputed, and unresolved identity attributes.
- **Purpose and responsibility coverage:** declared purpose, intended function, role, responsibilities, capabilities, limitations, obligations, authorized scope, and the authority responsible for defining or revising them.
- **Meaning and value provenance:** the source and authority of values, goals, commitments, priorities, and meaning-bearing claims. It must distinguish human-declared meaning, organizational purpose, assigned system objective, assistant task purpose, inferred preference, and unverified interpretation.
- **Purpose fulfillment and behavioral evidence:** the requirements and evidence used to evaluate whether an entity's actual capabilities and observed behavior align with its declared purpose and responsibilities. A purpose statement must not be treated as proof of fulfillment.
- **Human dignity and personhood safeguards:** requirements to preserve human dignity, autonomy, privacy, self-definition, rights-related obligations, and non-reducibility. It must explicitly distinguish human personhood from system identity and technical representation.
- **C2O and UNIVERSALIS alignment:** corresponding identity, purpose, lineage, and continuity structures; shared architectural declarations; edition-specific identities; governance differences; private-source restrictions; public-source commitments; and permitted interoperability.
- **Core intelligence separation:** the separate identity, purpose, lineage, responsibilities, governance, and authority of C2O Intelligence and UNIVERSALIS Intelligence. Matching purposes or capabilities must not establish merged identity or additional intelligence entities.
- **Operating-system identity:** the relationship between the underlying operating-system architecture, C2O and UNIVERSALIS editions, versions, builds, configurations, installations, deployments, and runtime instances.
- **Application identity:** the relationship between an application's underlying identity, purpose, edition, release, instance, configuration, and deployment, including the responsibilities and lineage associated with replacement or retirement.
- **Assistant and Guardian identity boundaries:** the distinct identity, purpose, role, responsibilities, permissions, and continuity of non-personal UNIVERSALINS assistants and personal UNIVERSALIN Guardians.
- **Guardian and human relationship authority:** the specific human to whom a Guardian is bound, the human-authorized purpose and scope, personal identity and information boundaries, correction rights, review responsibilities, permission changes, and termination authority.
- **Identity and purpose change control:** the conditions for defining, revising, transferring, replacing, superseding, or retiring identities, roles, purposes, commitments, and meaning-bearing information. It must identify applicable approvals and required records.
- **Continuity classification:** identity continuity, lineage continuity, purpose continuity, capability continuity, information continuity, implementation continuity, responsibility continuity, and governance continuity. The matrix must record which forms are established and which are not.
- **Mortality and finitude:** the lifecycle state, end conditions, decommissioning requirements, successor or replacement decisions, record retention, information disposition, and relevant human authority. It must distinguish system retirement from human mortality.
- **Recovery and restoration:** authoritative recovery sources, identity and purpose validation, lineage restoration, commitment review, permission validation, unresolved discrepancies, and criteria for establishing restored continuity.
- **Renewal and succession:** the distinction between revision, renewal, replacement, migration, succession, and establishment of a new entity. The matrix must establish what is retained, changed, transferred, superseded, archived, or deleted.
- **Privacy and existential information security:** access restrictions, source visibility, purpose limitation, retention, disclosure, correction, transfer, archival, and deletion requirements affecting identity and meaning-bearing information.
- **Evidence and verification status:** proposed, declared, documented, implemented, tested, verified, unverified, disputed, failed, or unresolved status, supported by relevant sources, authority, provenance, limitations, and evidence.
- **Ownership and lifecycle responsibility:** responsible owners, maintainers, reviewers, approvers, governance authorities, human decision rights, change controls, succession responsibilities, and retirement authorities.

Matrix entries must distinguish applicable, not applicable, implemented, unimplemented, unknown, incomplete, disputed, and unresolved conditions. A declared identity must not be represented as verified merely because it has been recorded. A stated purpose must not be represented as fulfilled without appropriate evidence. A proposed successor must not be represented as a continuous identity, and a retired system must not be represented as still active through residual identifiers or archived records.



Corresponding C2O and UNIVERSALIS entries must not be assumed equivalent merely because they share an underlying architectural purpose. The matrix must identify which identity and purpose structures correspond, which belong to a particular edition, which governance arrangements differ, which information remains protected, and which continuity claims have been established through evidence.

#### Structural Integrity and Governance

The Soul Alchemy Map and Matrix must remain complementary and mutually traceable. The map establishes identity structures, purposes, meaning relationships, lineage, dignity-related obligations, continuity, finitude, dependencies, and lifecycle boundaries; the matrix establishes their classification, applicability, requirements, implementation status, evidence, safeguards, governance, and verification. Neither substitutes for the other. Each material identity, purpose, lineage, relationship, or lifecycle requirement identified in the map must be traceable to its applicable matrix entry, and material matrix requirements must be supported by the relevant mapped structures and relationships.



**Identity must remain distinct from representation.** Names, identifiers, profiles, labels, configurations, records, capabilities, and embodiments may represent an entity or part of its identity, but no single representation must be treated as the entire entity. Identity claims must remain tied to appropriate sources, scope, context, lineage, and authority. A system must not assume another entity's identity through copied records, similar naming, migrated data, repeated interaction, or technical replacement. A representation of a human must remain incomplete and correctable; it must never be treated as a definitive substitute for that person's self-definition.



**System identity must remain distinct from human personhood.** C2O, UNIVERSALIS, operating systems, applications, and assistants may have defined identity, purpose, lineage, responsibilities, and continuity structures. Those structures do not establish human personhood, subjective selfhood, consciousness, sentience, metaphysical soul, or inherent human dignity. Human persons must not be reduced to technical identities or data representations, and technical systems must not be assigned human personhood merely because they have persistent identifiers, coherent descriptions, memory, capabilities, or lifecycle continuity.



**C2O and UNIVERSALIS must preserve their corresponding architecture and distinct edition identities.** They represent the private-source company edition and public open-source edition of the same underlying operating-system and application architecture. Their shared architectural identity, purpose correspondence, and public contracts must not collapse their edition identities, source visibility, internal governance, protected implementation, or authority. C2O private-source identity, purpose, and governance information must remain protected. UNIVERSALIS must maintain its independently operable public identity and must not require C2O private records or governance to establish its own continuity.



**The two core intelligences must remain distinct.** C2O Intelligence and UNIVERSALIS Intelligence may have corresponding responsibilities and coordinate through explicitly authorized interfaces, but neither may silently assume the other's identity, purpose, history, authority, governance, or commitments. Similar capabilities, shared contracts, mapped lineage, or coordinated outputs do not establish a merged intelligence. No additional core intelligence or independent entity is created by classifying a specialized existential capability.



**Non-personal assistants must remain distinct from personal Guardians.** UNIVERSALINS are non-personal assistants with assigned roles and purposes. UNIVERSALIN Guardians are personal human assistants bound to specific humans and operating under those humans' authority. Their identities, purpose declarations, roles, permissions, information boundaries, and continuity structures must remain separate. A non-personal assistant must not acquire a personal relationship or human identity through persistent interaction; a Guardian must not become a general-purpose system identity that absorbs personal context without human authorization.



**Human dignity must not be conditional on system interpretation.** Human dignity and personhood are not created, measured, assigned, or revoked by an operating system, application, intelligence, assistant, Guardian, profile, ranking, classification, capability assessment, or inferred preference. Soul Alchemy must ensure that system representations and decisions recognize the person's inherent worth and preserve the person's ability to challenge, correct, and reject representations that affect them. A person's value must not be reduced to productivity, utility, compliance, data availability, capability, health, age, identity category, or relationship to a system.



**Human identity and meaning must remain under appropriate human authority.** A system may help organize information, record declared goals, compare options, preserve commitments, or support reflection, but it must not claim authority to define a person's authentic identity, purpose, values, dignity, relationships, or life meaning. Inferred preferences and system-generated interpretations must remain distinguishable from the person's own statements and decisions. A Guardian must remain subject to the human it serves and must not use a representation of the human as grounds to override that human's self-definition or choices.



**Purpose must remain explicit and bounded.** Every material system, application, assistant, or Guardian purpose must have an identifiable source, context, scope, and responsible authority. Assigned purpose must not be treated as permission to use any means, access any information, or expand any responsibility. A system's purpose must remain distinct from a human's personal purpose, and an assistant's task must remain distinct from the purpose of its host operating system or application. Material purpose changes must be documented and authorized according to their context.



**Meaning and values must preserve their provenance.** Human-declared values, organizational commitments, system objectives, assistant instructions, inferred preferences, and externally attributed interpretations must not be conflated. Their sources, authority, context, and limitations must be identifiable. An inferred preference must not be presented as a human's confirmed value; an organizational value statement must not be represented as an individual commitment; and system behavior must not automatically be treated as proof of subjective motivation or intrinsic meaning.



**Dignity-related obligations must be applied across system boundaries.** Human dignity, privacy, autonomy, and rights-related obligations remain relevant when information passes between C2O, UNIVERSALIS, applications, non-personal assistants, and personal Guardians. Public-source availability does not remove privacy obligations, and private-source governance does not authorize disregard for a person's dignity or authority. Systems must preserve relevant protections when information is transferred, summarized, mapped, archived, or deleted.



**Continuity claims must be specific and evidenced.** Identity continuity, purpose continuity, capability continuity, information continuity, implementation continuity, responsibility continuity, and governance continuity must be evaluated separately. Reuse of a name, identifier, profile, or record does not independently establish continuity. Nor does a replacement implementation automatically inherit the identity, commitments, permissions, or obligations of a predecessor. Where continuity cannot be established, the gap or change must be explicitly recorded.



**Renewal must not erase necessary history or create false identity.** A renewed or replaced system may preserve selected identities, purposes, capabilities, and responsibilities while changing its implementation. The scope of preservation must be documented. Historical records required for provenance, accountability, human rights, or applicable obligations must be handled appropriately. New or successor entities must not be represented as the same continuing identity without an established basis. Renewal must also avoid preserving obsolete purposes, invalid permissions, or commitments that have been revoked or superseded.



**Mortality must distinguish system finitude from human life.** Technical termination, decommissioning, replacement, archival, and deletion are system lifecycle conditions. Human mortality is a human existential reality and must be handled with dignity, care, and appropriate human authority. A system or Guardian must not infer authority over a person's life, death, end-of-life wishes, estate, personal relationships, or personal records merely from its ability to maintain continuity or manage information. Human mortality must not be treated as a technical decommissioning decision.



**Existential information must remain protected and appropriately limited.** Identity records, personal histories, purpose declarations, values, commitments, relationship information, and Guardian context may contain sensitive or private information. Their collection, use, retention, sharing, transfer, archival, and deletion must remain within applicable permissions and purpose limitations. Personal information must not become public merely because it is processed through UNIVERSALIS, and C2O private-source governance must not be used to override the human's applicable rights or authority over personal information.



**Recovery must restore authoritative identity and valid purpose.** Recovery of existential structures must use appropriate authoritative sources and verify identity, lineage, edition, purpose, commitments, permissions, and dependencies. It must not silently restore obsolete identity declarations, revoked purposes, invalid commitments, or unauthorized relationships. Recovery of a record does not independently restore the entity or capability it describes. Partial restoration must remain identified as partial until the required identity and continuity conditions are established.



**Retirement must resolve identity, purpose, and outstanding obligations.** The retirement of a system, application, assistant, Guardian configuration, or capability must identify the affected identity records, public representations, commitments, responsibilities, relationships, dependencies, and information. It must establish which records are retained, archived, superseded, transferred, corrected, or deleted, and how residual identifiers and representations are handled. Retirement must not silently erase accountability or imply that all human obligations and consequences end when a technical system is removed.



**Claims about existential properties must be limited to available evidence.** Architectural descriptions, identity records, purpose statements, model behavior, persistent memory, and lifecycle continuity do not establish metaphysical soul, consciousness, sentience, subjective experience, personal identity in the human sense, or human-equivalent moral status. Such claims must not be inferred from functional capability or terminology. The taxonomy must distinguish declared conceptual models from implemented structures, observed behavior, verified properties, philosophical interpretations, and unresolved questions.



**Accountability must follow existential changes throughout their lifecycle.** Material changes to identity, purpose, meaning-bearing information, commitments, lineage, dignity-related safeguards, continuity, and lifecycle status must have appropriate records identifying their source, authority, scope, methods, affected entities, results, limitations, and verification status. Proposed, declared, authorized, attempted, completed, tested, and verified changes must remain distinguishable. The existence of an identity or purpose record does not establish its legitimacy, accuracy, consent, or fulfillment; those properties require their own supporting evidence.



All Soul Alchemy applications must preserve identity integrity, purpose clarity, meaning provenance, human dignity, autonomy, existential boundaries, lineage, continuity, finitude, recoverability, accountability, evidence integrity, privacy, and the distinct governance and authority of C2O and UNIVERSALIS. These requirements apply throughout the design, specification, declaration, development, configuration, integration, operation, evaluation, maintenance, correction, transformation, recovery, renewal, migration, succession, archival, conclusion, and retirement of existential and identity-bearing structures.
